items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And one of your trombone mates was Slim Moore, Alton Moore. Alton Moore, right, right, and I remember Whitney, somebody by the name of Whitney. ... [INTERVIEWER] James Whitney.
